t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colour of the baskets correspond to the colour of the knome and if you match them you get more points

vb_textbox.text: The colour of the basket depends on the colour of the knome. A red basket and a brown, pink, or other similar coloured knome will give more points. A knome that is for example green, orange, pink, will get more points with the yellow basket.
